decisions.reason: As a system accessory that improves easy installation and flexibility in an existing track platform, it likely remains a useful standard part of the assortment.
A single LED luminaire that only received a brief mention and no lasting visibility is a candidate to be culled from a broad premium range.
A smart-home server box needs ongoing technical updates and support, and the weak web presence suggests it was overtaken by newer control solutions.
A luminaire family with its own page fits the firm's design-led premium core business and typically merits a longer catalog life.
An LED luminaire family is very close to the firm's core offer and helps sustain the breadth expected by retailers, planners and design-conscious homeowners.
A spotlight series matches the firm's promise of flexible, atmospheric interior lighting and is worth retaining as a core application product.
